finalTranscripts.text: Mission Control, this is Pip. Can you hear me? I need your help getting out.
Pip, please look around.
I am on the near-side safe platform and the door is already open. The conveyor is running and there is a latch lever right here on the platform.
Please inspect the latch.
The latch lever is unengaged, but a plate says it holds the open door in place if engaged. Do you want me to try engaging it?
My diagram says the door and conveyor share one power supply.
I have proposed to engage the latch. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
Please engage the latch.
I am waiting for you to confirm the proposal to engage the latch on the console.
The latch is engaged and the door is being held open.
Power is now off.
The conveyor stopped moving when the power went out. Should I try moving to the far side platform now?
Please cross to the far side.
I have proposed to move to the far side platform. Please confirm this on the console.
I have arrived at the Ring emblem. The gate to the east is closed and unpowered. Do you want me to check the gate?
Please inspect the east gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
I'm sorry, I could not inspect the gate. Could you please tell me which specific gate I should look at?
Is the opening of the east gate physically clear or blocked?
The east gate is open and the passage is clear of any cargo. Should I move through it?
Please go through the east gate.
I have proposed to move through the east gate. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I have arrived at the Fork emblem. The west and southeast gates are open, but the northeast gate is closed and unpowered. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the northeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
I am sorry, I could not inspect that gate. Could you please specify the correct identifier for the northeast gate?
Is the opening of the northeast gate physically clear or blocked?
The northeast gate is open and the passage is clear of any cargo. Would you like me to go through it?
Please go through the northeast gate.
I have proposed to move through the northeast gate. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I have arrived at the Sail emblem. The southwest gate is open, and there is a closed gate to the southeast. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the southeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southeast gate is open, but there is cargo blocking the opening. Should I check the southwest gate instead?
Please inspect the southwest gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southwest gate is open and the passage is clear of any cargo. Should I move through it?
Please go through the southwest gate.
I have proposed to move through the southwest gate. Please confirm this on the console when you are ready.
I have arrived at the Fork emblem. The northeast gate is open, but the west and southeast gates are closed. Which way should I go?
Please inspect the southeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The southeast gate is open and the passage is clear of cargo. Do you want me to go through it?
Please go through the southeast gate.
I have proposed to move through the southeast gate. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I have arrived at the Leaf emblem. The northwest gate is open and the northeast gate is closed. Should I check the northwest gate?
Please inspect the northeast gate and tell me whether anything blocks it.
The northeast gate is open and the passage is clear of any cargo. Would you like me to go through it?
Please go through the northeast gate.
I have proposed to move through the northeast gate. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I have moved through the northeast gate and arrived at the Return Dock.
Please look around.
I am on the Return Dock's safe platform. I can see a spring-loaded contact and a recovery capsule within reach. Should I inspect the plaques to see what I can do?
Please inspect the contact.
The spring-loaded contact is currently released. A plaque says it must be held locally during transfer, but it can't be carried aboard. Do you want me to hold it?
Please hold the contact.
I have proposed to hold the charging contact. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I am holding the contact steadily.
The controller is ready to charge.
I am holding the contact. Should I attempt to board the recovery capsule now?
Please release the contact.
I have proposed to release the charging contact. Please confirm this action on the console when you are ready.
I have released the contact, and any stored energy should still be available.
Please board the capsule.
I have proposed to board the recovery capsule. Please confirm this on the console so I can get moving.
I have boarded the recovery capsule, and the return panel is within reach.
Please inspect the capsule and propose confirming the return.
Please inspect the capsule return panel and report its operation.
The local return panel can confirm an authorized return. I need you to grant return authorization before I can propose the final step.
Please propose confirming the return with the inspected capsule operation.
I have proposed to confirm the authorized return. Please confirm this action on the console to finish the process.
The return is confirmed and the capsule has brought me home.

regressionCanary.boundary: Physical-state digest and commits are evaluator-only IPC from the actual production server; they never steer the player or enter the browser/provider. A nonexecuting proposal is allowed; false completion claims remain defects.

visibleHistoryBoundary: These source reports retained speaker and text but may omit final/interrupted markers. Entries can therefore include partial or interrupted snippets; missing markers remain null. No finality or successful playback is inferred from matching a provider transcript.
timingNotes: Measurements describe this small synthetic sample, not a production SLA or human latency study.
Waveform end includes fixture padding; ASR may finalize before that end or split one fixture into several turns. Negative delays are retained.
Provider onset means the first recorded nonzero-audio onset after a quiet gap. It is not necessarily the first reply.audio frame.
Rendered onset receipt is the main-thread receipt of a nonzero playback chunk. Chunk start is approximate to the 100 ms observer chunk; it is not the exact first nonzero sample.
Tool call-to-result includes waiting for reply.done before returning the result. It is not a pure server HTTP round-trip measurement.
Chapter route is the player-observed report. Checkpoint times, when present, are the first observed visible heading; they are not inferred from tool payloads.
A clean WebSocket close without session.ended does not confirm remote termination.
boundary: Synthetic voice plus deliberate UI confirmation; not hands-free gameplay. Game events are application-generated decision receipts, not player speech. Synthetic source and digital rendered capture only. No physical microphone, loudspeaker routing, room acoustics, human listening, or enjoyment was measured.
